title: Christine S NDE 268
content: I remember passing out from the smoke and not being able to breath. I remember becoming aware of being in a dark place. There was no sound it was just dark. I seemed to be waiting there. Then I began to move toward a brightly lit area. The area appeared to be a bright yellow wall with uneven sections that had definite lines running along it. Along the lines, the edges were faintly pink. I was floating along this wall but could only see one side of it as if my back was against the other side. Yet I had no sense of having a body. I was just aware. As I continued to move along, I became aware of a feeling of horror. That's what I remember feeling. I had the intense urge to get out of there. I kept saying to myself that I have to get out of here. I repeated it several times and then I felt myself falling and everything was black again. I woke up in the emergency room with all of these doctors and nurses around me asking me if I knew who I was.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes fire Clinical death Dead on arrival from carbon monoxide poisoning from fire.
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I was me but had no awareness of having a body but I was definitely aware of myself.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning I knew I wasn't here.
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes When I came back I felt as though I was falling through a tunnel
elements.The experience included: Void | Darkness | Light | Strong emotional tone | Boundary
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes But not a point of light. It was just lit up.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm The area I was in was definitely a place but it went on and on unchanging.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: At first nothing, but as I was moving along the unchanging wall I began to feel horror about being there.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you reach a boundary or limiting phy: Uncertain The wall. But I only moved along it.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I made myself come back.
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I made myself come back. God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I fear death intensely because the horror of the place where I was, was due to the fact that I was totally alone.
elements.After the NDE: change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I fear death intensely because the horror of the place where I was, was due to the fact that I was totally alone. After the NDE
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes Unable to explain feelings and location.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: There was no best part. The worst part was being in that place alone.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes They say that's interesting but I don't know if they believe me. They seem more interested in the fact that I died.
